dog.description_text:
With a name so nice you have to say it twice, Deedee is ready to make her grand entrance into your life!

Deedee is a lovely girl who is looking for someone to share life's little adventures with. She is hoping her next chapter includes a loving home and a new best friend.

Deedee is still writing her story, and that's part of the fun! Getting to know a new dog means discovering all the little things that make them special. From finding out what makes her tail wag to learning her favorite ways to spend an afternoon, Deedee has plenty of moments waiting to be shared with her future pet parent.

Deedee is ready for all the experiences that come with finding a loving home. Whether it's establishing a new routine, exploring the neighborhood together or simply enjoying each other's company, there are so many memories waiting to be made. The best part is you'll get to discover what makes Deedee one of a kind along the way!

Every great friendship has to start somewhere, and Deedee is hoping hers starts with you. This sweet girl might just become your favorite part of coming home!

Ready to make some memories with Deedee? Click the “Adopt Me” button to learn more about this lovely girl.

You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 5 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.
